question: What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0, c1, c2, c3 FROM (SELECT T3.lap AS c0, T2.name AS c1, T2.year AS c2, T1.location AS c3, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY T3.lap DESC) AS __r FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT T3.lap, T2.name, T2.year, T1.location FROM circuits AS T1 INNER JOIN races AS T2 ON T1.circuitId = T2.circuitId INNER JOIN lapTimes AS T3 ON T3.raceId = T2.raceId ORDER BY T3.lap DESC LIMIT 1

c.request:
What is the most laps f1 races had? Name the race, year and circuit location where the races with most laps was hosted.
If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
c.sql: WITH race_laps AS (SELECT raceId, MAX(laps) AS laps FROM results GROUP BY raceId) SELECT r.name AS race, r.year, c.location, rl.laps FROM race_laps AS rl JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = rl.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE rl.laps = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM race_laps);

b.request: Which Formula 1 race or races have the highest lap count, measured by the maximum `results.laps` recorded for a driver in each race? Return every race tied for the highest count, with its name, year, and circuit location
b.sql: SELECT r.name, r.year, c.location FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name, r.year, c.location HAVING MAX(res.laps) = (SELECT MAX(laps) FROM results)

d.request: Which Formula 1 races had the most laps? Give each race’s name, year, and circuit location, and include all races tied for the most laps.
d.sql: WITH race_laps AS (SELECT raceId, MAX(laps) AS lap_count FROM results GROUP BY raceId) SELECT r.name, r.year, c.location FROM race_laps AS rl JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = rl.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE rl.lap_count = (SELECT MAX(lap_count) FROM race_laps) ORDER BY r.year, r.name
